claims.text: A DIA information memorandum to the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition, Technology and Logistics uses the name 'Advanced Aerospace Threat and Identification Program', reports the deliverables were of limited value to DIA, and proposes the project 'could be transitioned to another agency or component better suited'.
